title: The Entertainer

evidence.note: Wikipedia states the copyright on The Entertainer was registered December 29, 1902, along with two other Joplin rags, and it was published that year by John Stark & Son.

famous_use: The Sting (1973); Marvin Hamlisch's orchestral adaptation reached No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1974 and won an Academy Award for the film's score.
